description: Need decay — needs (hunger, happiness, energy, social) decrease at specified rates over time
steps: Create CareSystem struct with four needs (hunger, happiness, energy, social) each starting at 100.0
Call decay(Duration) with simulated elapsed time
Assert each need decreased by its decay rate * elapsed_time
Assert needs are clamped to [0.0, 100.0]

description: Mood calculation — mood correctly computed as weighted average of all needs
steps: Create CareSystem with known need values
Call calculate_mood() and verify mood = weighted average of needs
Test boundary: all needs at 100 → mood 100, all at 0 → mood 0
Test with mixed values: verify weighted calculation matches expected result

description: Mood affects pet animation and behavior — low mood causes sad animation, high mood causes happy
steps: Create CareSystem with mood below sad threshold (e.g., < 20)
Verify mood_label returns 'sad'
Create CareSystem with mood above happy threshold (e.g., > 80)
Verify mood_label returns 'happy'
Verify mood thresholds map to correct FSM state transitions

description: Feeding/petting/chatting replenishes needs — care actions increase specific need values
steps: Create CareSystem with hunger at 30
Call feed() and verify hunger increased by feed_amount
Call pet() and verify happiness increased
Call chat() and verify social increased
Call sleep() and verify energy increased
Verify values clamped to 100.0 max

description: Need persistence — care state (needs, mood) saved to SQLite and restored on restart
steps: Create CareSystem with specific need values
Save state to SQLite
Create new CareSystem and load from SQLite
Verify all need values match saved state

description: Scheduled triggers — morning greeting fires, break reminder after long sessions
steps: Create BehaviorScheduler with time-based rules
Simulate morning time (8-9am) and verify morning_greeting trigger fires
Simulate 60 min of continuous activity and verify break_reminder trigger fires
Verify triggers don't fire outside their conditions

description: Idle detection — detect user idle/active state from input activity
steps: Create ActivityDetector with configurable idle threshold
Record mouse/keyboard activity, verify state is 'active'
Advance time past threshold without activity, verify state is 'idle'
Record new activity, verify state returns to 'active'

description: Screen capture — periodic screenshot taken and describable by LLM
steps: Implement screen capture using xcap or screenshots crate
Capture primary monitor as image bytes
Verify captured image has non-zero dimensions
Verify image can be encoded to PNG for LLM vision input

description: Care UI — need bars, feed/play/sleep buttons, mood indicator displayed in frontend
steps: Start the app
Open the care panel UI
Verify need bars for hunger, happiness, energy, social are visible
Verify feed/play/sleep/chat buttons are present
Verify mood indicator shows current mood level and label

description: Sound effects — basic vocalizations play at appropriate times
steps: Create assets/sounds/ directory with basic sound files
Implement sound playback system
Verify happy sound plays when mood is high
Verify sad sound plays when mood is low
Verify hunger sound plays when hunger is critically low

description: Personality evolution — personality traits shift based on interaction patterns over time
steps: Load personality traits from database
After N positive interactions, cheerfulness should increase slightly
After N neglect periods, clinginess should decrease slightly
Verify traits are clamped to valid range [0, 100]
Verify trait changes persist to database

description: System prompt includes care state — prompt builder includes mood, needs, and user activity
steps: Build system prompt with care context (mood, needs, activity)
Verify prompt contains mood percentage and mood label
Verify prompt contains all four need levels
Verify prompt contains user activity state (active/idle/duration)
Verify prompt contains time of day
